name: WNBA_R3A5A_QUALITY_ADJUSTED_FORM_PREFIX_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Construct deterministic leakage-safe L5/L10 recent efficiency, efficiency delta, margin and opponent-quality-adjusted form features before any R3A5 OOS family evaluation.

source_custody.asset_rule: Every source asset must reproduce its frozen byte size and SHA-256 before a row can be emitted.

strict_temporal_custody.two_phase_same_date_sealing: For every official date D, construct every target row on D from histories containing only dates < D. Only after all date-D target rows are sealed may date-D game statistics enter team histories.
strict_temporal_custody.cold_start_rule: A target is excluded only if either side has zero prior finalized games in that season. No post-result exclusion is allowed.

frozen_possession_and_efficiency_semanti.season_window: All finalized games in the current season on official dates strictly before target date.
frozen_possession_and_efficiency_semanti.recent5_window: Last min(5, priorGameCount) finalized games by official date then game_id, all strictly before target date.
frozen_possession_and_efficiency_semanti.recent10_window: Last min(10, priorGameCount) finalized games by official date then game_id, all strictly before target date.

frozen_quality_adjustment.opponent_strength_for_occurrence: For each opponent occurrence in the side's recent window, compute that opponent's seasonNetEfficiency using all of that opponent's finalized current-season games strictly before the target date.
frozen_quality_adjustment.occurrence_weighting: Each recent opponent occurrence receives equal weight. Repeat meetings therefore count once per occurrence.
frozen_quality_adjustment.recent_opponent_avg_season_net_efficienc: Arithmetic mean of opponent seasonNetEfficiency across occurrences in the recent window.
frozen_quality_adjustment.direction: A positive opponent season net efficiency increases the quality-adjusted value; a negative opponent season net efficiency decreases it.
frozen_quality_adjustment.missing_opponent_state_rule: If any recent opponent occurrence has no strictly-prior target-date season state, fail construction for that target side; do not impute league average or zero.

constructor_gates: All six pinned assets reproduce exact custody.
Every season contains exactly the frozen regular-season game count after exclusions.
Every accepted game has exactly one HOME and one AWAY row with reciprocal opponent identity and one official date.
Every ingested prior-game possession estimate is finite and > 0.
Missing recent-opponent target-date state count is 0 for emitted rows.
Emitted row counts exactly equal 126,186,210,234,234,279 by season.
2021-2025 emitted game IDs exactly equal the frozen R1/R2 1,143-game population; 2020 exactly equals the frozen R2 126-game seed population.
